summary: The opt-in web publisher admits configured tailnet tags as distinct read-only preview identities, including the collections read WebSocket, while keeping browser pairing login-only and stripping identity headers before the daemon gateway.

compatibility.detail: Tag admission is opt-in through WF_TAILNET_TAGS; ambiguous login-plus-tag headers fail closed.

manual.detail: To enable tagged previews, configure WF_TAILNET_TAGS behind an identity-stripping filter and provide a read-only preview credential in WF_ST_AUTHORIZATION_FILE; restart the publisher.

recovery.detail: Unset WF_TAILNET_TAGS to disable tag admission.
